_note: Dates when posting method changed. Edit this file to add one: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, text, platforms (yt fb ig tt pin). 'stops' lists platforms whose tracking ends that day. Add "split": false to mark a day on the graphs without starting a new column in the post-type table.

events.title: Posting moved to API
events.text: Facebook posting moved off Buffer to the API pipeline. Reach fell to near zero from this day.

events.title: Posting route changed
events.text: Facebook API posting suspended; Facebook posting went back through Buffer. Test: can a different route overcome near-zero reach?

events.title: Pinterest disconnected
events.text: Disconnected from Buffer as a zero-reach test. Tracking stops here; earlier numbers stay.

events.title: Nature posts begin
events.text: Regular posts paused; a new kind of nature post replaces them. Test: can they beat the 2-second swipe-away?

events.title: Nature-Hear posts begin
events.text: Tomorrow's-episode posts discontinued (last one 11/8). The new Nature-Hear post, a nature card opening with the Hear Jesus Here promo ending, takes their place.
